name: terminal-portfolio
description: Interactive terminal portfolio — a forkable template. Add a command by dropping a file in src/commands/.

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && gh-pages -d dist --dotfiles -m 'deploy'
scripts.deploy:s3: npm test && npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$S3_BUCKET --endpoint-url $S3_ENDPOINT --delete'
